    Ext¹ from a free presentation #

    For a free presentation P of Z with generator map g₀ : Aⁿ⁰ → Z and syzygy Ω = ker g₀, Ext¹_P(Z, W) = Hom_A(Ω, W) / {restrictions of maps Aⁿ⁰ → W} (Ext1). When the relation rows are free generators of Ω (P.Free, i.e. pd Z ≤ 1 with this resolution), Ext¹_P(Z, W) is Wⁿ¹ / F Wⁿ⁰ (ext1EquivCoker), and the Auslander–Reiten formula reads dim Hom(W, τ_P Z) = dim Ext¹_P(Z, W) (finrank_hom_tau_eq_ext1).
